authorization_context: User accepts technical recovery and continuation of already authorized caption and Stronger Performance Energy private previews.
actions: Fetch current branch and inspect newer execution evidence first. Do not dispatch duplicate jobs or repeat completed preparation.

Local executor: diagnose Resolve UI/API availability using supported tools. Determine active project, unsaved work and running renders before any restart. Save/export when accessible. Use normal launch/reconnection or graceful restart where safe; do not force quit with unknown unsaved work, delete lock files or mutate project databases. Escalate only a concrete unrecoverable access/data-loss risk.

Resume the already authorized text-free Stronger Performance Energy private 72–96 second preview once Resolve is responsive. Reuse existing verified bindings; check changed inputs rather than blindly redoing analysis. Validate musical timing, lipsync, expression and crop, then render and QC. No dependency on caption fonts.

Caption worker: if existing project font bytes remain unavailable, download Montserrat and Cinzel from their verified official publisher or Google Fonts distribution. Read and retain the supplied licence, source URL/version and SHA256; select brand-required styles. No paid pack, font substitution or third-party installer. Install/activate per-user fonts through supported mechanisms when permitted and verify exact family/styles in Resolve FontManager. Obey genuine platform permission prompts; do not label a routine font lookup as a Nitin creative approval.

Resume caption kit native export and private comparison after font verification. Verify actual glyph rendering, HLG/10-bit output, safe areas and full decode. Do not replace demonstrated preset reuse with a config-only claim.
Parallel agents may prepare independent files, but only one executor owns Resolve at a time. No concurrent project saves or renders. Do not interrupt an active task in another session.

Obtain independent Gemini QC on actual rendered outputs when available, preserving explicit technical/display limits. Deliver any completed private preview without waiting indefinitely for an unrelated blocked task.
Persist completed artifacts and hash/readback evidence in authoritative Shared Drive and narrow GitHub changes. Do not assert a review link or render exists without verification.

Keep event/ledger history intact. Do not elevate Master State during the known integrity hold. Record actual outcomes in task evidence; absence of font bytes or a transient UI failure is a technical blocker, not a newly invented human creative gate.
